title: Radius of Gyration

variables.k: Radius of gyration about the specified axis
variables.I: Moment of inertia about the specified axis
variables.M: Total mass of the rigid body

assumptions: Rigid body of total mass M
validity_conditions: Universal geometric definition representing the effective distance at which whole mass could be concentrated
common_misuse: Treating radius of gyration as an intrinsic geometric constant independent of axis location
